payload.title: FUN-settings: public-process proof for Operator Settings after INV→CLN→DEL vertical completion

Do not invent new pkg/root or pkg/wire Operator Settings helper APIs solely for tests
Functional proofs construct the process only through root.BuildProcess and replace effects only via edges.Edges
Do not invent Settings HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters (HTTP-SET/CLI-SET/MCP-SET already Factory-terminal) or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX

payload.requestedOutcome: Prove Operator Settings as a packaged service through public process composition only: root.BuildProcess, public Operator Settings protocol surfaces (HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters already terminal), and edges.Edges effect replacement. Validate and, only where needed, extend focused functional proofs under tests/functional/operator_settings so operator-config/defaults resolution, identity/input inventory, and Settings transports remain inert until runtime lifecycle starts, then exercise public Operator Settings behavior without importing operator_settings/internal or deleted transitional Settings packages (servicewire/, identityinventory/, testlink/, testproviders/) from outside the owner and without inventing pkg/root or pkg/wire test-only composition helpers. Retarget any remaining functional proofs still bound to deleted servicewire/ paths onto public Settings surfaces. Confirm no production peer reaches Operator Settings through deleted transitional packages. Do not fold or delete packages (including residual testdata/). Do not invent Settings protocol adapters or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX. Do not open PSS-I0* shared integrators. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
